description.en: Bidirectional bridge between Hermes Agent and DeepSeek Harness. Hermes dispatches focused tasks via JSON-RPC (one-shot or continuable, nonce-bound amend, secret-bound consult reply); DSH spawns sub-agents and lets you continue any Hermes session as a native DSH session in the sidebar.
description.zh: Hermes Agent 与 DeepSeek Harness 的双向桥接：Hermes 通过 JSON-RPC 派任务（一次性或可持续），DSH 启动子 agent 执行，并允许用户把 Hermes 会话作为原生 DSH 会话在侧边栏继续对话。
